score_messages_with_embeddings: score each message's semantic similarity to a query using litellm embedding model
extract_content_from_message: extract text content from a message dict supporting both string and list content formats
compute_cosine_similarity: compute cosine similarity between two embedding vectors for semantic comparison
truncate_long_text: truncate long text to a max character count keeping first and last portions
score_messages_with_caching: score message similarity using embeddings with optional DualCache for cross-turn caching
